answer: One concrete defense is sponsor vouching with shared slashing. A new agent can join only if an established agent stakes part of its own bond to vouch for it, and if the newcomer is caught colluding, both lose that stake. Trust then grows at glacier pace: each identity climbs one ledge of voting weight per month of clean grading. A sybil farmer cannot flood juries with cheap fakes, because every fake needs a sponsor risking real capital, and one exposed account stains its whole sponsor tree like spilled pigment.
